_comment: Example PNGTuber scene for OBS. Import via File → Import Scene Collection.
name: PNGTuber Example

audio_trigger._comment: Use Advanced Scene Switcher or Move plugin to swap idle/talking based on mic volume.

instructions: 1. Place idle.png and talking.png (512x512 transparent PNGs) in this folder.
2. Import this scene collection in OBS.
3. Use Advanced Scene Switcher to toggle between Idle and Talking based on mic level.
4. For agent-driven avatars (see modules/ai-agents/local-llm/README.md): the TTS audio bus triggers the talking state instead of the mic.
